_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: A name of the available architectures (PARAMS.<architecture>) found in scarab repository, which defines the machine parameters of the default configuration.
_experiment: Top-N-per-branch marked-load force-hit oracle vs perfect-D$ ceiling on datacenter. Measures how much of the branch-stall headroom is captured when only the N most-important delaying loads per branch are perfectly prefetched (marked as L1 hits). Each marked_hit config sets --branch_load_dep_addr_replay 1 --branch_load_dep_addr_replay_coverage 1 and points --branch_load_dep_trace_dir at the matching bld_topn_record_datacenter output dir, so br_addr_replay_hit() force-completes exactly that (N,rank)'s recorded braddr line set at L1 hit latency (dcache_stage.c: op->done_cycle = cycle_count + DCACHE_CYCLES + extra_ld_latency; the fill still issues). baseline = real D-cache (floor). all_hit = --perfect_dcache_hit_latency 1 (every load hits = ceiling). mh_all = force-hit the full recorded delaying-load set (mechanism ceiling). Headroom captured by N = (IPC[mh_nX] - IPC[baseline]) / (IPC[all_hit] - IPC[baseline]). PREREQUISITE: run bld_topn_record_datacenter first (same suite + top_simpoint) so each *_braddr.csv exists; a workload/config lacking one marks no loads and behaves as baseline.
_workload_manager: manual: run each exp scenario with all the simpoints at a time, slurm: Slurm schedules simulations based on its policy
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home, for instance, the user's home directory
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: The path to the scarab repository that contains the scarab binary used to run the experiment. Must be built from the bld-attr-topn-loads-per-branch branch (same binary that produced the record CSVs).
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces
_top_simpoint: Run only top 3 simpoints stored in 'workloads_top_simp.json'. MUST match bld_topn_record_datacenter so each marked_hit config reads back a braddr.csv for every simpoint it runs.
_simulations: Datacenter suite (same selection as the record pass).
_configurations: Force-hit oracle sweep over N and ranking. Each mh_* config force-hits (coverage 1.0) the line set recorded by the matching bld_topn_record_datacenter config, via --branch_load_dep_trace_dir pointing at that config's dir. baseline = floor, all_hit = perfect-D$ ceiling, mh_all = full delaying-load set. _cyc = cycles-ranked record, _crit = criticality-ranked record.

baseline._params: Real D-cache, no force-hit oracle. Floor of the comparison.

mh_n1_cyc._params: Force-hit the N=1/cycles recorded set (topn_n1_cyc), coverage 1.0.

mh_n2_cyc._params: Force-hit the N=2/cycles recorded set (topn_n2_cyc), coverage 1.0.

mh_n3_cyc._params: Force-hit the N=3/cycles recorded set (topn_n3_cyc), coverage 1.0.

mh_n1_crit._params: Force-hit the N=1/criticality recorded set (topn_n1_crit), coverage 1.0.

mh_n2_crit._params: Force-hit the N=2/criticality recorded set (topn_n2_crit), coverage 1.0.

mh_n3_crit._params: Force-hit the N=3/criticality recorded set (topn_n3_crit), coverage 1.0.

mh_all._params: Force-hit the full delaying-load set (topn_all, N=0), coverage 1.0. Marked-load mechanism ceiling.

pf_n1_cyc._params: Timed seqnum-driven prefetch of the N=1/cycles set (topn_n1_cyc): 100% accuracy (success rate 1.0), lookahead 512, fill L1D, normal LRU (no feeder protection).

pf_n2_cyc._params: Timed seqnum-driven prefetch of the N=2/cycles set (topn_n2_cyc): 100% accuracy, lookahead 512, fill L1D, normal LRU.

pf_n3_cyc._params: Timed seqnum-driven prefetch of the N=3/cycles set (topn_n3_cyc): 100% accuracy, lookahead 512, fill L1D, normal LRU.

pf_n1_crit._params: Timed seqnum-driven prefetch of the N=1/criticality set (topn_n1_crit): 100% accuracy, lookahead 512, fill L1D, normal LRU.

pf_n2_crit._params: Timed seqnum-driven prefetch of the N=2/criticality set (topn_n2_crit): 100% accuracy, lookahead 512, fill L1D, normal LRU.

pf_n3_crit._params: Timed seqnum-driven prefetch of the N=3/criticality set (topn_n3_crit): 100% accuracy, lookahead 512, fill L1D, normal LRU.

pf_all._params: Timed seqnum-driven prefetch of the full delaying-load set (topn_all): 100% accuracy, lookahead 512, fill L1D, normal LRU. Timed counterpart of mh_all.

all_hit._params: Perfect-D$ hit-latency oracle: EVERY load completes at L1 hit latency on a miss (still issues the fill). Ceiling of the comparison.

_collect_stats: Stats collection settings for ./sci --collect-stats. configs: optional list of configuration names to collect (null or omitted = all configurations).
_mem: Memory scheduling and collection settings for Slurm jobs.
